genAiWarning.label: GenAI Warning
genAiWarning.tooltip:
Add a notice warning for usage of generative AI to the top of page.

Be sure to include the source attributing the usage of generative AI for verified cases (e.g. video description, producer comment, etc.), or an explanation detailing inconsistencies that raise credible suspicion of generative AI usage for non-verified cases.

contentWarning.label: Content Warnings
contentWarning.tooltip:
Add content warnings to the top of page.

Setting a song as NSFW will automatically place the song page behind an NSFW content warning popup and hide the lyrics behind a toggle.

You are required to add the justification for adding a content warning, e.g. if it contains violent/sexual content.

Refer to the section § Content Warnings on our Warning Templates Guideline for more information.

songLanguage.label: Song Language
songLanguage.tooltip: The language the song lyrics are written in.

languageIsoCode.label: Language ISO Code
languageIsoCode.tooltip:
The ISO Language of the original lyrics, used to ensure proper rendering of the lyrics column (refer to this blogpost for more details on how this works).

List of ISO Language Codes: [W3Schools] [Library of Congress]

romanizedTitle.label: Transliterated Title
romanizedTitle.tooltip: Transliterated song title (if Original Title is not in the Roman alphabet)

englishTitle.label: Translated Title
englishTitle.tooltip: Song title translated to English (if non-English original)

altChineseTitle.label: {mode} Chinese Title
altChineseTitle.tooltip: Song title in alternate Chinese script (e.g. Traditional/Simplified Chinese script).

singers.label: Singer(s)
singers.tooltip:
Markup for singer(s), e.g.:

[[Kagamine Rin (VOCALOID)]] and [[Kagamine Len (VOCALOID)]]

Be sure to check whether the correct singer category has been put in.

producers.label: Producer(s)
producers.tooltip:
Markup for producer(s), one per line, e.g.:

[[Tanaka Kazuto]] (music, lyrics)
Pikucha (illustration)

Categories will be loaded automatically based on the markup.

broadcastLinks.label: Broadcast Links
broadcastLinks.tooltip:
Links to play song, one per line.

Recognized links: youtu.be, youtube.com, nicovideo.jp, piapro.jp, soundcloud.com, bandcamp.com, vimeo.com, bilibili.com

The Vocaloid Lyrics Wiki supports a variety of services that may not be included in this table. Refer to the section § All Recognized Website Domains on our template documentation to find out more.

Leave URL empty if there's no play link available (e.g. the song is not publicly available or the song is an album-only release).
broadcastLinks.isDemonstration: Song is a vocal synth demo

songTypes.label: Song Type
songTypes.tooltip:
Cover songs are only allowed on the wiki if they feature a singing vocal synth and have at least 1,000,000+ views.

A spin-off is a vocal synth song that uses the same composition as another vocal synth song but has significantly different lyrics.

A mashup/medley is a song that blends two or more existing songs together. Only official mashups or medleys should be added.

Refer to the section § Covers on our Song Article Guideline for more information.

lyrics.label: Lyrics
lyrics.tooltip:
Copy & paste original, transliterated and translated lyrics here.

Apply custom styles by adding in-line CSS rules to the first column of this table, e.g.

color:red;

font-weight:bold;

font-size:1.2rem;

translator.label: Translator
translator.isOfficialTooltip: Is the translation approved by the producer?

categories.label: Categories
categories.tooltip:
Category names, one per line, e.g.:

wowaka songs list

Click the Autoload button to generate categories automatically based on producer credits. Song series categories, if necessary, should be added manually.
